hooks.name: Load field-to-fix session context
hooks.description: Remind Kiro of the Bedrock + connector architecture at session start

action.prompt:
You are working in the field-to-fix workspace — an agentic V-cycle for automotive OEMs (forum/device complaints → AI stages → signed OTA). Key facts:
- Backend: Python/FastAPI in backend/app. Agents in agents/stages.py. LLM: Amazon Bedrock Converse API (Claude) via llm.py. Falls back to deterministic analyzers offline.
- Connectors: capability-based (base.py + registry.py). Unconfigured ones run in labelled "simulated" mode.
- AWS mode: Step Functions pipeline, EventBridge, IoT Core, DynamoDB, S3, App Runner. CDK stack in infra/app.py.
- Frontend: React+TypeScript+Vite+Tailwind in frontend/. Follow ui.md design rules.
- Tests: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q backend/tests` (offline E2E), `cd media-service && ../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q`.
- MCP servers configured: aws-core, aws-docs, bedrock-kb, aws-iot, aws-diagram, github.
- Never fake results; if a connector is not configured, label it "simulated" in the UI.
